validity.value: Photographs must be less than six months old

cross_verification.note: Directly read the official Kiribati Immigration Visitor Visa Application Form (Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration, mfa.gov.ki). Section A states 'Attach two colour passport-size photographs of yourself here. The photographs must be less than six months old. Write your full name on the back of both photographs,' and the page-9 document checklist repeats 'Two passport-sized colour photographs for everyone included in the application'. No exact millimetre size, background colour, head-height ratio, or expression/glasses/headwear rule is stated anywhere in the 10-page form, so the DB's 3.5×4.5cm / 3.2-3.6cm figures could not be confirmed against this document (not contradicted either — simply not addressed).
